message: The PS criterion uses the susceptibility fold; its gain is exactly one at the edge. A NaN PS gain beyond the edge means no stable transverse susceptibility exists.
No mean-mode crossing before the real PS susceptibility branch ends. A resolved PS_MEM boundary is required to call this preemption.
MEM equations did not converge at alpha=0.48; relative residual=1.348e-03 (required 1.000e-06).
